arabic: إِذَا عَطَسَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَقُلْ: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَلْيَقُلْ لَهُ أَخُوهُ أَوْ صَاحِبُهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ، فَإِذَا قَالَ لَهُ: يَرْحَمُكَ اللهُ، فَلْيَقُلْ: يَهْدِيكُمُ اللهُ وَيُصْلِحُ بَالَكُمْ.
transliteration: Alhamdu lillaah. (Your companion should say): Yarhamukallaah. (You reply): Yahdeekumullaahu wa yuslihu baalakum.
translation: When any of you sneezes, he should say: 'All praise is to Allah.' His brother or companion should say to him: 'May Allah have mercy on you.' When he says, 'May Allah have mercy on you,' the one who sneezed should say: 'May Allah guide you and set your affairs in order.'
